items.text: Since 2017, guns are the leading cause of death for US children, surpassing car crashes. However, experts said that the number of car crash deaths decreased. Nevertheless, this problem is uniquely American, with US children being 15 times more likely to die from guns than children in 31 other high-income countries. Children were shot while riding their bikes, walking home from school, or even playing video games. A 2015-2019 study revealed that 9 million children lived in a neighborhood with at least one fatal shooting per year. The same study also found that compared to white children, Black children had a higher risk of exposure to gun violence. Children suffer gun injuries from accidental shootings, crossfire , suicide , and also partner violence. Difficult words: fatal (deadly), crossfire (gunshots from multiple people), suicide (when a person takes his own life intentionally). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Guns are the main cause of death for American children. Since 2017, more children died because of them than other causes. In the past, most children died in car accidents, but this isn’t true anymore. Experts say that it’s because the roads are safer. Gun violence is a big problem in the US. 15 times more children die from guns in the US than in 31 other rich countries. A study found that 9 million children lived in an area where gun violence happened. The study also found that the situation was more serious for Black children than for white children. Some children die from guns when they ride their bike or walk in the street. Sometimes the gunshot is an accident, but it can be from suicide or family problems, too. Difficult words: cause (the reason why something happens), gun violence (behavior to hurt or kill with a gun), suicide (an action to kill yourself). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Guns kill many children in the US. More children die from guns than anything else. In the past, many children die in car accidents. Now roads and cars are safer. Guns are a big problem in the US. 9 million children live in a place where guns shoot people. Children die when they ride a bike. Someone shoots them when they walk from school. They die when they play. Black children die more often than white children. Children are shot for many reasons . Sometimes an accident happens. Sometimes family problems happen. Sometimes a suicide happens. Suicide is when someone chooses to kill himself. Difficult words: shoot (to use a gun), reason (why something happens), accident (something unplanned that happens). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Eight synchronized radio telescopes worked together around the world to capture the first image of the black hole at the center of the Milky Way galaxy. The Event Horizon Telescope gave scientists the first look our black hole; scientists call it the Sagittarius A star. The image shows a bright ring that surrounds the darkness, the telltale shadow of the black hole. The object is four million times the size of our Sun, and the ring is about 60 million kilometers, roughly the size of Mercury’s path around our star. The image doesn’t actually show the black hole but the material, gas, and dust that it is swallowing in real time. Nobody knows what happens in the center of a black hole or at the edge of it because the black hole’s gravity is under extreme conditions. The image can teach scientists how matter behaves under these conditions, and it can help them understand the nature of gravity itself. Difficult words: synchronized (operating at the same time or rate), telltale (a sign of something), matter (physical substances in the universe). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists showed the first image of the black hole which is at the center of our galaxy. The image doesn’t actually show the black hole. The black hole’s gravity is so strong that we can see only a bright ring around it. The ring is the material, gas, and dust which the black hole is swallowing. The black hole is four million times the mass of our Sun. The ring around it is about 60 million kilometers, which is about the same as Mercury’s orbit around the Sun. To take the image, scientists used eight different telescopes around the world. They believe the image will help them understand gravity and how materials behave in the black hole. Difficult words: gravity (the strength which pulls objects together), mass (an amount of something), orbit (the path of an object around a planet or star). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists show the first picture of the black hole in our galaxy . A black hole is a special object in space. It has very strong gravity . The black hole will swallow anything that gets too close. Eight different telescopes take pictures of the black hole. They are around the world. Scientists then make one picture from the pictures. The picture doesn’t actually show the black hole. It shows a ring. The ring is material, dust, and clouds around the hole. The ring is about 60 million kilometers. The mass of the black hole is very big. It is about the mass of four million Suns. Scientists believe that they will understand gravity better. Difficult words: galaxy (a system of millions of stars, clouds, and dust), gravity (the strength which pulls things together), mass (a bunch of something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Time-lapse footage shows the Southern Lights, the southern hemisphere’s version of the Northern Lights. As a starlit sky slowly turned, spectacular swathes of red, purple and blue light swept up into the night over New Zealand. Aurora sightings were also seen in Australia, America and across Europe. A collision of particles in the earth’s atmosphere with electrically-charged particles released by the sun are what causes auroras. They are visible all year-round but are they are most vivid around the spring and autumn equinoxes . Difficult words: spectacular (amazing), swath (a large and thin area), aurora (light that looks like waves up in the sky), particle (a small bit of energy), vivid (colourful and clear), equinox (when the night and the day are equal length). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Just like the northern hemisphere’s Northern Lights, the southern hemisphere has the Southern Lights that also appear at night and also are called auroras . Auroras happen when particles in the earth’s atmosphere hit with particles coming from the sun’s atmosphere. You can see the amazing auroras all year but the best time to see them is during the spring and autumn equinoxes . A camera recently filmed the big bands of colours passing over New Zealand. People also saw the Southern Lights in Australia, America and Europe. Difficult words: aurora (a large and wide line of coloured light in the sky), particle (a little piece of energy), the spring and autumn equinoxes (the days exactly in the middle of spring and autumn). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are Southern Lights in New Zealand. A camera films them. People also see them in Australia, America and Europe. The Southern Lights are like the Northern Lights. People also call them auroras . You can see them at night in the sky. They look like big lines of colours. They move. They are very pretty. You can see them all year. You can see them really well two times a year. That is during the spring and autumn equinoxes . Difficult words: aurora (a big line of light in the sky), equinox (when you are in the middle of a season), particle (a little bit of energy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On a riverbank in New South Wales, Australian police found an unconscious man who was wearing high-end diving equipment. Nearby, they found several packages that contained a white powder. Police estimated the worth to be about $14 million of a suspected 50 kilograms of cocaine. Despite paramedic treatment, the man died at the scene. Police later identified the man was a foreign national . Police didn’t know if the two incidents were linked. They also searched an overseas-registered ship docked near the crime scene, and they talked to the crew. Divers are searching the surrounding waters, and authorities are seeking help in identifying two small boats. People reported they were near the ship on Sunday night. Difficult words: high-end (of very good quality and usually expensive), national (a citizen of a particular country), dock (to stay at a place where ships load or unload things). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Near the Hunter River in New South Wales, Australian police found an unconscious man in expensive diving equipment. Paramedics tried to help him, but he died. Near the body, police found 50 kilograms of white powder. They believed it was cocaine; its worth may be about $ 14 million. Police didn’t know if the man had something to do with the cocaine. They searched a ship which docked nearby, and they talked to the crew. Divers searched the river, and authorities asked people for help to find two boats. Someone saw them in the area on Sunday night. Difficult words: unconscious (when a person looks as if he is asleep, and he doesn’t react to anything), paramedic (a person whose job is to help injured or ill people), dock (to stay at a place where ships load and unload things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Police find a man near a river in New South Wales, Australia. The man is wearing expensive diving equipment . He is not moving and not dead. Paramedics want to him. He dies later. Police find 50 kilograms of white powder near the man. They believe that it is cocaine. Cocaine is a very expensive drug. The powder may sell for $14 million. Police don’t know if the man does something with the cocaine. They search a nearby ship. They talk to many people. Some people say that two small boats are in the area the night before. Police ask the public for help. They must know more about the boats. Difficult words: equipment (things which people use for one task or activity), paramedic (a job to help hurt or ill people), public (all of the people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Bono and the Edge are members of the Irish rock band U2; they performed at a subway station in central Kyiv on Sunday. The musicians said that they were performing at the invitation of Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyi, and they called the visit a gesture of support for the Ukrainian people and their leader. The duo performed for 40 minutes at Khreshchatyk metro station in front of a crowd of about 100 people, including fans and uniformed members of Ukraine’s armed forces. Many subway stations in Ukraine’s capital were temporarily bomb shelters while Putin’s forces tried to capture the city. At the end of March, Russia moved its forces from the city to concentrate them in the east of the country. Difficult words: gesture (an action that supports a feeling or intention), duo (two people), capture (to take by force). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyi invited Bono and the Edge to Kyiv, the capital city. They are the singer and the leading guitarist of the Irish band U2. The musicians performed at a subway stations; Ukrainians had used it as a bomb shelter . About 100 people watched the gig who were fans and soldiers. The musicians said that they didn’t agree with the war, and they wanted to show their support for Ukraine. They also said that young Russians probably knew about the real situation in Ukraine. Russian soldiers tried to control the capital city, but they weren’t successful. At the end of March, they left Kyiv to fight in the east of Ukraine. Difficult words: perform (to entertain people by dancing, singing, or playing music), bomb shelter (a place where people hide from bomb attacks), gig (a show for a musician or a band to play live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two members of the Irish rock band U2 come to Ukraine. The Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyi invites them. Bono is the singer. The Edge is the guitarist. They play in the subway in Ukraine’s capital of Kyiv. About 100 people watch them play for 40 minutes. Fans and soldiers in uniforms watch. The musicians say that they want to show support to Ukraine. They play some of the band’s biggest hits. Russia attacks Kyiv in March. Russian soldiers never control the city. They move to fight in the east of Ukraine. Difficult words: member (a person who belongs to a group or organization), subway (an underground train), support (a way to help). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Afghanistan’s Taliban government ordered women to cover their faces in public. The policy is a return to their past strict rules, and the escalation of restrictions caused anger at home and abroad. According to the rule, if a woman doesn’t cover her face outside her home, the police may prison her father or closest male relative, or bosses may fire them from state jobs. The ideal face covering is the all-encompassing blue burqa that women wore in public during Taliban’s rule in 1996 – 2001. Most women in Afghanistan wear a headscarf for religious reasons; however, in urban areas, such as Kabul, many women don’t cover their faces. Western governments and some religious scholars and Islamic nations have criticized Taliban for limiting women’s rights, including closing girls’ high schools. In recent months, the Taliban brought in regulations that limit women’s movements without a male chaperone , and they ban men and women from visiting parks together. Difficult words: escalation (an increase in the intensity or seriousness of something), encompass (to cover or surround), chaperone (a person who supervises another person or people in public). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Taliban ruled in Afghanistan between 1996 and 2001, and during this time, women had to cover their faces in public. Last week, the Taliban government ordered women to cover their faces again. This new rule made many people angry in Afghanistan and in other countries, too. If a women doesn’t cover her face, her father or closest male relative can go to prison or lose his job. Most women in Afghanistan cover their faces for religious reasons, but in big cities like Kabul, many women don’t cover them. Many people say that the new rule stops women’s rights . The Taliban also introduced a rule that woman must be outside with a man. People were also angry when the Taliban closed some high schools for girls. Difficult words: rule (to have power; an instruction which says what people can or can’t do), male (a man), right (the things a person can do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 1996 to 2001, the Taliban is in power in Afghanistan. Women must cover their faces outside of the home. Now, the Taliban orders women to cover their faces again. Many people are angry. Many women in big cities don’t cover their faces. Some women cover their faces because of religion . Afghan women have more rules from the Taliban. A woman must be outside with a man. Her father or the closest man in her family can get in trouble if she doesn’t follow the rule. He can go to prison or lose a job. The Taliban closes high schools for girls. Many people say that this rule is against women’s rights . Difficult words: religion (a belief in a god and activities that you do for this belief), rule (an instruction which tells people what they can or can’t do), right (what a person can do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In northern Pakistan, the historic Hassanabad Bridge collapsed on Saturday after a Shipser glacial lake outburst . The bridge was one of the main bridges on the Karakoram highways, and its collapse stranded thousands of people. The bridge connected northern Pakistan and China, and it was a popular tourist attraction, famous for being one of the world’s highest paved roads. The glacier lake outburst occurred after an intense heatwave hit Pakistan and neighboring India. The heatwave brought severe wildfires and dangerous air quality. Over the past 20 days, the water volume in the glacier lake increased by 40% as a result of the unusually high temperatures. The heatwave released the huge amount of water into the stream and surrounding areas in the Hunza Valley. Pakistan has the highest number of glaciers outside the polar region, and many are losing mass due to high global temperatures. The incident alarmed experts; they said that rising temperatures in the country could lead to more glacial floods. Difficult words: outburst (a sudden release of power), stranded (unable to leave a place because of a difficulty), mass (a large amount of something that has no specific shape or arrangement). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Some weeks ago, a heatwave hit Pakistan and India, and high temperatures melted the area glaciers faster. Experts watched one of the glacier lakes in the past month, and they saw it had 40% more water than usual. On Saturday, a Shipser lake burst, and it caused floods in the Hunza Valley. The floods destroyed a historic bridge, which connected northern Pakistan and China. It was part of the Karakoram highway, and when in collapsed, thousands of people couldn’t leave the area. The bridge was one of the highest paved bridges in the world, and many tourists visited it. Pakistan is the country with the world’s most glaciers, and experts worry that more floods will happen more often in the future. Difficult words: glacier (a slow river of ice in the mountains), glacier lake (water which comes from melted glacier), paved (an area covered with stones or bricks). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Pakistan has the most glaciers in the world. As the world is warming, the glaciers are melting . A heatwave hits Pakistan and India a few weeks ago. Scientists watch one glacier lake. A glacier lake has water from a melted glacier. 40% more water is in the lake. Suddenly, the lake bursts. Too much water comes out. Water floods an area in northern Pakistan. The water collapses a very old bridge. Many tourists visit this bridge. The bridge is also a part of an important highway. The highway connects Pakistan and China. Thousands of people can’t leave the area. Difficult words: glacier (a river of ice in the mountains; the river moves slowly), melt (to turns into water from snow or ice), collapse (to fall or to make fall to the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After last Monday, US abortion rights advocates said demand and donations spiked because the news reported that the Supreme Court may overturn Roe Vs. Wade. The 1973 court case legalized abortion in the US; it caused a lot arguments. Politicians and lawmakers have attacked it for years. Prior to Monday, many US states limited abortions; people expect these states will ban abortions if Roe Vs. Wade is overturned. Then, other states will decide if they will allow the procedure. One organization said it received over $130 thousand in donations. The organization gives money to abortion clinics to help women with the cost of abortions. Another organization also reported an increase in appointments since Monday. It gets abortion pills from a company called Aid Access. Abortion pills are an alternate option instead of the medical procedure; now they are very common in the US. Aid Access works with US and foreign doctors and pharmacies to get medications, and the US government cannot fully police its work with foreign countries. Difficult words: spike (to increase suddenly), overturn (to stop something that was allowed previously), police (to control). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

US abortion organizations said that demand and donations increased. On Monday, the news reported that the Supreme Court may overturn Roe Vs. Wade. The 1973 court case legalized abortion in the US, and many people were upset. Some people have attacked it for years. Before Monday, many US states limited abortion. People expect they’ll stop all abortions if Roe Vs. Wade is overturned. Other states will decide what to do. Pills are a new option for abortion. They are now very common in the US. One medicine company works with the US, foreign doctors, and pharmacies to get the medications. The US government cannot fully control its work with foreign countries. Difficult words: the Supreme Court (the most powerful court in a country; it allows or ends laws), overturn (to end something that was allowed), legalize (to allow something to happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Monday, the US news says that the Supreme Court may end a law. The law is from 1973. It is called Roe Vs. Wade. It lets abortion happen in the US. The law is important in the US. Some people think that women must have it. Other people think it is bad. Before Monday, many US states say how women get abortions. If the law ends, these states may stop all abortions. Other states will think about what to do. Pills are a new option to get an abortion. They are now very common in the US. One medicine company works with the US and foreign doctors and companies. The US government cannot control its work with foreign countries. Difficult words: the Supreme Court (the most powerful court that starts or ends laws), abortion (a medical job to take a baby out of a woman), foreign (from another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Wednesday, technology company Meta gave a preview of its first physical store. It will open on May 9 to sell the Oculus Rift, its virtual reality headset. It will also promote the Metaverse, which has virtual reality spaces for people to visit. The store is in Burlingame, California, USA, at Meta’s virtual reality department. It creates and sells its devices such as the headset, video chat devices, and smart glasses. The store will also have a website where people can buy items. CEO Mark Zuckerberg said he thinks that the Metaverse will be the next big computing platform, and the company invested a lot of money into it. However, he said it may take a decade for it to become popular. Difficult words: preview (an early chance to see or visit a place), promote (to sell and explain), invest (to spend money and make something bigger). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Wednesday, technology company Meta let people briefly see its first physical store. The store will open on May 9, and it will sell Meta’s virtual reality headset . It will also share information on the Metaverse, which has virtual reality spaces for people to visit. The store is in California, USA, at Meta’s virtual reality department. It makes and sells its devices such as the headset, video chat devices, and smart glasses. The store will also sell items online. Meta’s CEO said he thinks that the Metaverse will be the next big technology platform , and the company spent a lot of money on it. He also said it may take a 10 years for it to be popular. Difficult words: brief (a short time), headset (an electronic device that you wear on your head) , platform (a technology system where you play games, work, or learn). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Wednesday, technology company Meta opens its first physical store. They let people visit for a little time. The store will officially open on May 9. The store will sell its virtual reality devices . It will also share information on the Metaverse. The Metaverse is virtual reality technology. People can be together in the virtual reality. The store is in California, USA. It is at Meta’s virtual reality department. It makes and sells its devices. The store will also sell items online. Meta’s boss says he thinks that the Metaverse will be popular. His company spends a lot of money on it. He also says it is very new. People may like it after a long time. Difficult words: physical (a place or thing that you see or touch), virtual reality (technology that makes a place or things look real, but it is all in a computer), device (an electronic system such as a computer, smart phone, or game machine). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qantas Airways is launching the world’s longest non-stop commercial flight from Sydney, Australia, to London, England, and it’s ordered a dozen special Airbus jets for the flight. The airline will charge higher fares to save four hours on the popular route that takes 24 hours. The route’s nickname has been the ‘kangaroo route’, since all its flights have to stop for fuel. The flights will use A350-1000 aircraft configured with extra premium seating and reduced overall capacity. In 2020, the company was 11 weeks to bankruptcy, and it transformed to survive. The long-discussed breakthrough will boost Qantas’s marketing. The company’s CEO announced the multi-billion-dollar deal on Monday, and he said that the flights will start in late 2025. Qantas made the biggest aircraft order in its history, and the company’s stocks surged to the highest in months. Difficult words: configure (to prepare for an operation in a particular way), premium (a bonus or extra), breakthrough (an event that improves a situation or solves a problem). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Qantas Airways is planning to start the world’s longest non-stop flight in 2025. In a multi-billion-dollar business, the company ordered Airbuses A350-1000 for the flight from Sydney to London. People call this trip the ‘kangaroo flight’, since it is necessary to stop for fuel. The new flight will take 20 hours, and it’ll be four hours shorter than other flights, since the planes will continue to fly. In 2020, Qantas Airways nearly went bankrupt , and the company made big changes. During the COVID-19 pandemic airlines had strict rules for travel. Afterward, the demand grew for non-stop flights grew, which helped Quantas recover. Difficult words: non-stop (a thing that can continue without stopping), go bankrupt (to not be able to pay money which you owe), demand (a time when many people want something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qantas Airways is an Australian airline company. It will start the world’s longest non-stop flight in 2025. The flight will go from Sydney to London. This flight usually is 24 hours long. Planes must stop for fuel . The new flight will be four hours shorter. It will have fewer seats. It will have more passenger space. Passengers will pay more money to go on this flight. Qantas Airways orders planes for billions of dollars for this flight. The company has big money problems in 2020. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the rules change for plane. This situation helps Qantas Airways get more business again. Difficult words: non-stop (without a stop), fuel (a substance or material that people use to power vehicles and machines), passenger (a person who travels by bus, train, plane, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Saturday, club Real Madrid won the second La Liga title in three years after a convincing 4-0 victory against club Espanyol. At the Estadio Santiago Bernabéu in Madrid, Spain, tennis star Rafael Nadal did the honorary kickoff. Player Rodrygo scored twice in the first half, before players Marco Asensio and Karim Benzema added two more goals in the second half. They then completed a comfortable victory. Club Real Madrid now has won 35 league titles, nine more than its biggest rival team Barca. Real dominated in Spain this season when it won 25 league games and lost just three. Thus, the manager of Real Madrid, Carlo Ancelotti, has become the first manager to win the Premier League, the Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, and La Liga in his coaching career. Difficult words: convincing (clear), honorary (given or done as an honor), dominate (to be the most important or noticeable part of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Saturday, club Real Madrid won against club Espanyol, and Real Madrid won the second title of Spanish La Liga in three years. Tennis star Rafael Nadal started the match with an honorary kickoff . Player Rodrygo scored two goals in the first half, and players Arensio and Benzema added two more goals in the second half. Real Madrid won 4-0 and it the club earned its 35 th league title. Real Madrid won 25 games in La Liga this year, and it lost only three. Real Madrid manager and former AC Milan player Carlo Ancelotti became one of the most successful coaches , since he won titles from four different leagues, such as the English Premier League and the German Bundesliga. Difficult words: honorary (when someone does something as a reward, not in a usual way), kickoff (the start of a soccer match), coach (a person who trains a team or player). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Club Real Madrid wins at the Spanish La Liga on Saturday. It is Real Madrid’s second title in three years. Real Madrid plays with Espanyol on Saturday. Tennis star Rafael Nadal starts the match. Player Rodrygo scores two goals in the first half. Players Arensio and Benzema score two more goals in the second half. It is a clear victory for Real Madrid. Real Madrid wins its 35 th title in La Liga. Carlo Ancelotti is the manager of Real Madrid. He plays for AC Milan in the past. He is one of the most successful coaches . He wins titles in four different leagues. Two of them are the English Premier League and the German Bundesliga. Difficult words: title (the position in the first place in a sports competition), victory (a time that you win), coach (a person who trains a team or player). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A salon owner and hairdresser in Sao Paolo, Brazil, etches famous portraits onto his client’s heads. He has been carving profiles of the famous onto the sides and backs of heads for about a year or so. He says that his works makes him really happy, especially when he inspires young people to want to know about cutting hair just as Neymar, whose face he often etches, inspires people to get into soccer. When it comes to cutting famous faces, the hairdresser starts with a regular hair clipper that he uses to cut the image freehand without any stencilling. He does this by simply looking at an image, either from a piece of paper or a smartphone. Once the basic outline is there, he carefully uses a razorblade to cut in the more detailed elements . If a client wants, he can also add elements of colour. One of the images that he has done include hip-hop artist Snoop Dogg, Jesus Christ, and even a replica of Da Vinci’s ‘The Last Supper’. Difficult words: etch (cut into something to make a picture), freehand (make by using your hand), stencilling (using an image to trace or fill in), element (a part), replica (a copy). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

After he got a new idea about a year ago, people are noticing a hairdresser in Brazil who shaves and cuts hair on people’s heads to create portraits of famous people. Holding a picture or a smart phone, he shaves the hair to make an outline of a picture. Then he uses a razorblade to make details and afterwards can add colour. The hairdresser said that cutting hair this way makes him happy but he is also happy that young people who are interested in his pictures of a famous footballer are now becoming also interested in hairdressing. Difficult words: portrait (a picture), outline (the basic parts of something), razorblade (a small, thin and very sharp thing for cutting). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A hairdresser has an idea. He makes a picture on somebody’s head. The picture looks like a famous person. Now, many people know about the hairdresser. He is happy. He says that young people like football. He makes pictures of famous football players. Now, the young people also like hairdressing . They ask him questions. They want to learn. Difficult words: hairdresser (a person who cuts and styles hair – styling hair is making it look some way), hairdressing (cutting and styling hair). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A landfill in New Delhi, India caught fire during a scorching heatwave. Local people tried to keep themselves out of the heat from an unusually early heatwave with extreme temperatures in the South Asian country. It raised concerns that such weather conditions may be the new normal. The India Meteorological Department forecast that the maximum temperature may reach 43 degrees Celsius in New Delhi. Climate change experts have warned that heatwaves may intensify in South Asia in coming years. In most parts of India, the summer months are always extremely hot before monsoon rains bring cooler temperatures. In recent years, heatwaves have caused a number of deaths in India, especially among low-income workers and the homeless, who were outside in hot conditions. 2015 had the worst heatwave in India since 1992, and it killed more than 2,000 people. Difficult words: scorching (very hot), intensify (to become stronger or more extreme), monsoon rain (the heavy rain that accompanies the seasonal wind of Southern Asia in summer). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A heatwave hit India, and it brought very hot temperatures to the country. The heatwave came unusually early, which made people worried that such weather can become more usual in the future. Local people tried to keep out of the sun, while experts predicted that the temperature in New Delhi may reach 43 degrees Celsius. In India, the summer months are always very hot before monsoon rains bring colder weather. This year’s heatwave came very early, and experts warned that heatwaves would may stronger because of global warming . Heatwaves in India kill many people every year. The worst heatwaves were in 1992 and then in 2015, and the second heatwave killed more than 2,000 people. Difficult words: predict (to say what will happen in the future), monsoon rain (the heavy rain which comes with strong winds in Southeastern Asia in summer), global warming (when the earth is warmer because of weather changes and human activity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A heatwave hits India. It happens every year. This year, it happens early. Experts say that the temperatures may be 43 degrees Celsius. People try to stay out of the sun. Poor people and people without homes are in danger. They have nowhere to go. People worry that heatwaves will may be stronger in the future. Heatwaves kill many people every year. The worst heatwave in India is in 2015. It kills more than 2,000 people. Monsoon rains bring colder weather in the summer. They stop the heatwave. Maybe stronger heatwaves are from global warming . Difficult words: heatwave (a long time of very hot weather), monsoon rain (the heavy rain in Asia in summer), global warming (when the earth gets warm from weather and human activity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A person filmed a video of a wild fox taking bread and meat from people and stacking it into a sandwich. This happened in the Chernobyl disaster zone. The clip, which people have viewed more than a million times, was filmed by Radio Free Europe journalists on a trip. In the video, you can see the fox stacking the filling between the bread into a big sandwich that can barely fit in its mouth while it shows no fear of the humans. The Chernobyl nuclear plant exploded in 1986, and Russia established a 20-mile zone around it. Difficult words: stack (put things on top one another), filling (the parts that go inside the sandwich, such as cheese or meat). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A fox did something very unexpected for some journalists who went to Chernobyl, Ukraine, so one of them filmed what happened. The fox wasn’t afraid of the people, so they gave it some bread and meat, and the fox stacked it all into a sandwich! The sandwich was almost too big for it to eat, but it swallowed it down. The journalists saw this happen in the 20-mile exclusion zone around the Chernobyl nuclear plant that exploded in 1986. No people live there now and instead more foxes, wolves, and bears live there. Difficult words: unexpected (surprising), stack (to make a pile), exclusion zone (a place you cannot enter because it is dangerous). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The EU acted with unprecedented speed and unity to sanction Russia; however, energy is the EU’s weak spot. Before the war in Ukraine, Russia provided the EU with a huge percentage of its energy imports, 47% of its coal, 41% of its gas, and 27% of its oil. Thus, Russia supported transportation, heat, and electricity for households and big industries. Large economies like Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands especially depend on Russia. The EU is now phasing out Russian coal by this summer, and it wants to reduce Russian gas by two thirds by the end of this year. Ukrainian president Volodimir Zelensky accused European countries of making money from blood, since Russia is using the money to buy weapons. The EU has paid more than 46 billion euros to Russia for its energy since the beginning of the war in Ukraine. Last month, US president Joe Biden promised to send more gas to Europe, and internally , Europe can also increase its nuclear energy production. Difficult words: unprecedented (never done or known before), phase out (to gradually stop using something), internally (inside). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

When Russia attacked Ukraine in February, the EU acted very quickly to give consequences to Russia. Interestingly, the EU is still buying energy from Russia. Since the start of the war, the EU paid Russia more than 46 billion euros for its energy. Ukrainian president Volodimir Zelensky said that the EU made money from blood because Russia bought weapons with the money. The EU wants to end imports of Russian coal this summer. Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands are countries which buy the most Russian energy. Now, they must get it from somewhere else. They can possibly buy from the US, and the EU can also make more nuclear energy . Difficult words: household (a group of people who live in a home), import (when you buy things from another country), nuclear energy (a type of energy which comes from the smallest things called atoms). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After Neil Parish admitted that he’d watched pornography twice in Parliament, he told the BBC he was resigning as an MP. On Friday, the Conservative Party suspended Parish over the allegations . Two female colleagues claimed they saw Parish looking at adult content on his phone. Parish said that the first time was accidental after he was looking at a website related to tractors; however, the second time was deliberate. The MP apologized to his wife and family. He initially resisted calls to resign; however, under significant pressure, he changed his mind. He said he wouldn’t await the findings of the inquiry, and he would resign. Difficult words: pornography (books, magazines, or films that show sexual acts or naked people), allegation (a claim that someone did something illegal or wrong), adult content (content that’s not appropriate for children). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: MP (a Member of Parliament), pornography (books, magazines, or films which show people having sex), inquiry (an official request for information). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

90-year-old Meri Mion said that she will never forget her last birthday. She celebrated it last week. Meri was 13 years old when she and her family hid on their Italian farm as German and American forces fought in the last days of World War II. When they awoke to see the US liberation of their village, Meri’s mother baked her a birthday cake, and she left it to cool on the windowsill . However, it disappeared, and apparently hungry US soldiers took it. 77 years later, a special ceremony remembered the arrival of US forces in the town of Vincenza in 1945, and US soldiers presented Meri with a new cake to replace the old one. During the war, Italians greeted US soldiers with cheers, wine and bread. The US and local Italian officials said that eight decades later, the relations were still warm. Difficult words: liberation (the time to set people free), replace (to put something or someone in the place of something else), windowsill (a shelf below a window). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An explosion at an illegal oil refinery in southern Nigeria killed at least 110 people, and it drew attention to this lucrative business. In Imo state, the blast left devastation at the plant where bodies were burned beyond recognition . Nigeria’s security forces said that they were looking for two suspects as possible perpetrators of the explosion. Workers at illegal refineries steal crude oil from official pipelines, refine it in the bush, and they then sell it on the black market in Nigeria or export it. Over the last decade, illegal oil refining became a huge employer in the Niger Delta due to rising unemployment. Workers camp at refineries for weeks, and they often work at night. Besides the high risk of explosion, these refineries cause major air and water pollution. Difficult words: lucrative (when you make a large profit), beyond recognition (to such a degree that someone or something can’t be recognized), perpetrator (a person who committed a crime). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: oil refinery (a place where people clean crude oil, and they make petrol or other products from it), attention (when someone listens, sees, or notices something), unemployment (when a person is without a job). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The International Atomic Energy Agency said that Russian soldiers risked a serious accident when they attempted to get control of the Chernobyl nuclear plant in Ukraine. In February, Russian troops moved into the radioactive Chernobyl exclusion zone while they were on their way toward Kyiv, the Ukrainian capital. They withdrew last month as Russia switched its focus to fighting in eastern Ukraine. Rafael Mariano Grossi, the chief of the agency, said that the situation was unstable at the site and nuclear authorities were on alert. Grossi thanked workers at the power plant for mitigating potential risks during the occupation, which also included moments of power disruption . The plant is now back in Ukrainian control; however, Russian forces continue to hold the Zaporizhzhia plant in southern Ukraine, where there was fighting that damaged its training facility in early March. Difficult words: exclusion zone (an area where people aren’t allowed to go), mitigate (to lessen the seriousness), power disruption (an interruption in the supply of electricity). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The soldiers stayed for weeks at the site, and they got into a dangerous area which was contaminated with radiation . People weren’t normally allowed to go there. Officials said that there was a risk of an accident, but workers at the site tried to make the situation less serious. The plant was even without electricity for some time. Last month, Russian soldiers left Chernobyl, as Russia focused on the fight in eastern Ukraine. They still control another nuclear plant in southern Ukraine. Difficult words: nuclear plant (a plant which makes electricity from the smallest things called atoms), contaminated (unclean or polluted with a dangerous substance), radiation (a form of energy which people can’t see and is dangerous to all living things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Difficult words: nuclear plant (a plant which makes energy from the smallest things called atoms), radiation (a type of power which we can’t see and is dangerous), risk (to possibly get hurt). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Unknown attackers launched hand grenades against a state building in the Moldovan republic of Transnistria. The incident caused concerns that the Russian-backed area could join the war in Ukraine. The incidents put the country’s government on high alert, and president Maia Sandu said that she knew of several bomb alerts in schools and medical institutions. She also knew of an escalation of tension in the past few weeks. Sandu added that Moldovan authorities were following the events with caution and vigilance . The escalation attempts came from within the Transnistria region, where pro-war forces are interested in destabilizing the situation. However, the region is a part of Moldova, and its citizens live there. Difficult words: escalation (a situation in which something becomes greater or more serious), vigilance (the state of keeping careful watch for possible danger), destabilize (to make a government or area lose power or control). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: bomb alert (an incident when someone says that he put a bomb somewhere, and everyone has to leave the area), pro-war forces (a group of people who believe that a war is right), unstable (when it seems that something will change or fall). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
